name: 2D Gaussian Probability Density (Conic)
aliases: 2D Gaussian Probability Density from Conic and Rescale
definition: Computes the unnormalized probability density of a 2D Gaussian at a point `xy` given its mean, conic matrix components, and a rescaling factor. The conic matrix is the inverse covariance matrix.
summary: Computes the unnormalized 2D Gaussian density using a conic matrix and rescaling factor, differing from the standard version by operating directly on the conic representation.
